verdict.rationale: Bolt's first-party docs say that published projects on its built-in hosting can attach a custom domain the user owns or buy one through Bolt. A dedicated domains page also says an already-purchased domain can be connected to a Bolt project. Missing for 10: detailed setup steps (DNS records, SSL provisioning, verification) are not evidenced, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect a custom domain to my published app

citations.quote: you can attach a custom domain you own (like yoursite.com) or buy a domain through Bolt
If you've already purchased a custom domain, you can connect it to your Bolt project.
Bolt offers built-in hosting, so you can publish your Bolt project for free at a web address ending in `bolt.host`.
